WITH qc_by_funding AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    COUNT(*) as qc_count
  FROM scanqc q
  INNER JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
aggregate_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(qc_count) as total_qc,
    COUNT(*) as funding_source_count,
    CAST(SUM(qc_count) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL) as avg_per_funding
  FROM qc_by_funding
)
SELECT 
  qf.fundflux,
  qf.qc_count,
  CAST(qf.qc_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(ast.total_qc AS DECIMAL) as fraction_of_total,
  CAST(qf.qc_count AS DECIMAL) / ast.avg_per_funding as ratio_to_average
FROM qc_by_funding qf
CROSS JOIN aggregate_stats ast
ORDER BY qf.fundflux;
